clusters.title: Gemma-3 `gemma_rmsnorm` undefined on ROCm during CUDA-graph capture

details.label: Status
details.text: **NEW today**, first failing run Jul-27 13:02 UTC; passed the immediately-preceding scheduled run. Regression window [`3863612023..db9143ee`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/compare/3863612023...db9143ee08d1aee2f313ea44b6e35ec23454b5c3).

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[FACT]` commit [`08af5aea`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/08af5aea) ([#32383](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32383), Jul-27) rewrote `Gemma3RMSNorm.forward_cuda` (`layernorm.py:1084,1087`) to call bare `gemma_rmsnorm`/`gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm`, which are imported only under `if _is_cuda or _is_xpu or _is_musa:` — never on HIP. `Gemma3RMSNorm` has no `forward_hip`, so ROCm falls through to `forward_cuda` → NameError. Sibling `GemmaRMSNorm` correctly overrides `forward_hip`. **Disconfirming**: (none — stack trace + git-blame + clean pass/fail window converge).

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none — [#32261](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32261) is CUDA-fusion-related but adds no ROCm path.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: add `Gemma3RMSNorm.forward_hip` mirroring `GemmaRMSNorm.forward_hip` (`layernorm.py:930-940`, `rocm_triton_gemma_rmsnorm` else `forward_native`), or revert [`08af5aea`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/08af5aea); re-run `test_triton_sliding_window.py::test_cuda_graph` on MI325. Ping the [#32383](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32383) author.
